ideas.title: Uncovering the Extent of Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the entities and programs involved
questions: What is the full extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
Which entities and programs are involved?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and waste in the Medicaid program. By analyzing data and following the money, we may be able to identify patterns and connections between entities that can inform future investigations and policy decisions.
